name: 使用 SAP Risk and Assurance Management 的隐私风险检测 (3KX)
name_en: Privacy Risk Detection with SAP Risk and Assurance Management (3KX)
description_en_html:
Overview

With SAP Risk and Assurance Management data protection and privacy controls, SAP establishes effective means to analyze and detect data protection and privacy anomalies in your connected SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system.

The use of personal information is strictly regulated by various regulations and privacy risks exist when this type of data is collected and processed. As a supplement to manual governance, this scope item enables the automatic detection of privacy risks for personnel information and relevant documents (such as sales orders), providing insights on regulatory reporting and proactive auditing.

Key Process Flow

  • Create automated procedures
  • Create controls
  • Create work packages
  • Run automated procedures
  • Display automated procedure run result

Business Benefits

  • Automate data protection and privacy risk detection based on legality check for data stored within SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition in relation to privacy regulations
description_zh_html:
概览

通过 SAP Risk and Assurance Management 数据保护和隐私控制，SAP 建立了有效的方法来分析和检测连接的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统中的数据保护和隐私异常。

个人信息的使用受到各种法规的严格监管，并且在收集和处理此类数据时存在隐私风险。作为手动管理的补充，此范围项目支持自动检测人员信息和相关文档（例如销售订单）的隐私风险，提供对监管报告和主动审计的分析。

关键流程流

  • 创建自动化程序
  • 创建控制
  • 创建工作包
  • 运行自动化程序
  • 显示自动化过程运行结果

业务优势

  • 根据对 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中存储的数据进行的隐私法规合法性检查，自动检测数据保护和隐私风险
